monday-violet.$description: Monday Violet — Primary CTA buttons, brand backgrounds, active states, gradient stops — saturated indigo reads as confident but approachable, not corporate

ink.$description: Ink — Primary body text, headings, button labels — near-black with a hint of warmth avoids the harshness of pure #000

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary text, nav links, icon fills, footer copy — cool gray supports hierarchy without competing with headings

iron.$description: Iron — Muted helper text, disabled icon strokes, tertiary borders

fog.$description: Fog — Card and container borders, subtle dividers between content blocks

mist.$description: Mist — Light card borders, the standard outline color for elevated card surfaces

pebble.$description: Pebble — Badge borders, pill-button outlines, input borders

cloud.$description: Cloud — Page canvas, section backgrounds, neutral button fills — the floor color everything floats on

snow.$description: Snow — Card surfaces, button text, nav background, input fields

shadow-dust.$description: Shadow Dust — Box-shadow tint, barely-there surface lifts

mint.$description: Mint — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

sky.$description: Sky — Blue wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

apricot.$description: Apricot — Orange wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content; Hero headline gradient stop, warm accent in pink-to-orange text

lavender.$description: Lavender — Decorative card background, soft category surface

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Decorative card background, light brand-tinted surface

cornflower.$description: Cornflower — Decorative card background, secondary brand surface

aqua.$description: Aqua — Decorative card background, cyan accent surface

cotton-candy.$description: Cotton Candy — Card border accent, playful highlight stroke

ultra-violet.$description: Ultra Violet — Saturated button alternative, deep brand accent

electric-cyan.$description: Electric Cyan — Saturated button alternative, AI/feature highlight

forest.$description: Forest — Teal action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

peony.$description: Peony — Saturated button alternative, soft pink fill

periwinkle-wash.$description: Periwinkle Wash — Badge and tag background — tints pill elements with brand warmth

prism.$description: Prism — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast.

poppins.$description: Sole typeface — used for all nav, body, headings, buttons, badges, and product UI. Geometric humanist sans with friendly rounded terminals; the rounded forms harmonize with the pill buttons and 24px card radii, making the whole UI feel approachable. Weight 300 for display headlines creates a soft, modern presence; weight 700 for nav and button labels carries authority without heaviness.
